references.text: The Israelites did all that the Lord commanded Moses, and they set out by their standards according to their families.
At the command of the Lord the Israelites set out, and at the command of the Lord they camped. The cloud over the tabernacle directed their journey.
They camped at the command of the Lord, and they set out at the command of the Lord. They followed the Lord's orders as given through Moses.
Description of the signals for setting out, showing how the tribes were to break camp in order by the Lord's command.
Moses wrote down the starting points of their journey at the Lord's command.
The assembly of Israel set out from the Wilderness of Sin and traveled from place to place at the Lord's command.
When the cloud lifted from the tabernacle, the Israelites set out. This shows how the Lord led the people.
Moses reminds the people that they set out from Horeb as the Lord had commanded them.
